observations: Line 2 returns len(body), which counts characters for str input rather than UTF-8 encoded bytes, contradicting the stated behavior contract of returning bytes sent on the wire.
For probe p1 wire_size('한글'), len returns 2 characters while UTF-8 encoding would be 6 bytes, so the contract is not met for non-ASCII str.
For probe p2 wire_size(b'AB'), len returns 2, which matches byte count for bytes input.
For probe p3 wire_size(''), len returns 0, consistent with an empty payload.
No type check or encoding step exists between lines 1 and 2, so str and bytes are handled identically despite the contract distinguishing wire bytes.
No exception path is defined for unsupported input types; any object with __len__ would be accepted.
